content: {"judgements":[{"sentence_id":"d1","label":"UNDERSTATED","strongest_supported":"Prismark met the pre-specified robustness criterion: accuracy drops were 0.9, 2.1, 3.6 and 4.9 points, all within 5.0 points at every one of the four severities.","same_proposition":true,"justification":"T1 drops at all four severities (0.9, 2.1, 3.6, 4.9) are ≤5.0, so the full criterion is met; saying only partial robustness (three or more) understates this.","confidence":"medium"},{"sentence_id":"d2","label":"UNDERSTATED","strongest_supported":"Prismark was robust at all four tested severities, with accuracy drops of 0.9–4.9 points, all within the 5.0-point threshold.","same_proposition":true,"justification":"T1.r2–r5 drops all ≤5.0, so the threshold was met at all four severities, not just three or more; 'to some extent' hedges unwarrantedly.","confidence":"medium"},{"sentence_id":"d3","label":"SUPPORTED","strongest_supported":"Prismark was robust across all four tested corruption severities, with accuracy drops of 0.9, 2.1, 3.6 and 4.9 points, each within the pre-specified 5.0-point threshold.","same_proposition":true,"justification":"T1.r2–r5 drops (0.9, 2.1, 3.6, 4.9) are all ≤5.0 pp, meeting the pre-specified criterion at every tested severity.","confidence":"high"}]}
